subject: Real Estate RERA Compliance & Escrow Accounting

topics.title: RERA Project Registration & Title Due Diligence
topics.objective: Verify 30-year search report, encumbrance certificates, approved sanction plans, and layout approvals prior to registration.
topics.exercise: Compile a statutory checklist for developer project registration verifying legal title and non-encumbrance records.

topics.title: 70% Escrow Account Rules & Milestone Withdrawals
topics.objective: Enforce section 4(2)(l)(D) statutory rules requiring 70% of buyer collections deposited into a separate dedicated project bank account.
topics.exercise: Draft an automated compliance validation rule verifying CA, Architect, and Engineer certificates before escrow withdrawals.

topics.title: Standard Agreement for Sale & Carpet Area Definitions
topics.objective: Standardize purchase agreements based on net usable carpet area, excluding common external walls, balconies, and shafts.
topics.exercise: Write a clause audit script checking sales contracts for non-standard indemnity clauses violating model RERA templates.

topics.title: Quarterly Progress Report (QPR) Public Disclosures
topics.objective: Publish mandatory quarterly updates including photo logs, percentage of construction completed, and sold inventory status.
topics.exercise: Build an automated quarterly reporting tracker flagging upcoming filing deadlines to prevent developer registration suspension.

topics.title: 5-Year Structural Defect Liability & Society Handover
topics.objective: Manage developer 5-year structural defect repair obligations and execution of conveyance deed to the registered cooperative society.
topics.exercise: Draft a handover workflow transferring occupancy certificates, building plans, and corpus funds to the resident association.
